revision_reason: The first comparison did not cross all three methods with Raw and Graph. Existing Python predictions are an unassigned Parquet/ontology pilot, not a paired interface experiment.

paper.title: OpenRCA 2.0: From Outcome Labels to Causal Process Supervision
paper.alignment: retrospective design and metric-coverage audit; not an exact paper replication or preregistration

primary_metric.definition: Unchanged upstream diagnosis_correct: causal scope, locus, fault category and accepted mechanism must all match.
primary_metric.denominator: all scheduled completed investigations, including abstentions, invalid submissions and runner failures
primary_metric.incomplete_cohort: accuracy remains null; never replace pending investigations with either correct or incorrect outcomes
primary_metric.independent_unit: case; repetitions and multiple backbones do not create new independent cases

methods.label: Python LogAgent
methods.input_protocol: direct Parquet telemetry plus internally reconstructed ontology

methods.label: LogAgent candidates + original Raw loop + HF

required_interface_design.raw: Original read-only GreptimeDB SQL/PromQL telemetry surface; constructing relations from observed spans internally remains allowed.
required_interface_design.semantic_graph: Same Raw telemetry surface plus actual GreptimeDB Semantic Graph catalog, profiles, entities, relationships and query tools. Not publisher causal_graph.json.
required_interface_design.python_adapter_gap: Current Python code reads Parquet directly. Neither original Raw access nor Semantic Graph access has been implemented and measured as a controlled pair.
required_interface_design.llm_graph_gap: Current candidate bridge accepts only Visibility.RAW; the HF workflow has no semantic_graph arm.
required_interface_design.architecture_policy: Keep LogAgent's hypothesis, time, ontology and scoring architecture fixed in both arms. Do not substitute ontology-off versus ontology-on for the original interface comparison.
required_interface_design.comparability: Same cases, telemetry, windows, source hashes, output schema and scorer; same HF weights and sampling for both LLM methods and interfaces.
required_interface_design.paper_evaluation_gap: All six conditions need common root_causes/propagation output and paper outcome/process scoring before claiming paper-method compliance. This is not implemented by the reporting matrix.

hf_measurement.selection_policy: Use this preselected run only, never select the best later run.

historical_reference.role: historical descriptive reference, not a matched HF control

answer_semantics.selected_case_root_loci: one component, directed edge, or infrastructure node per case
answer_semantics.directed_edge: both endpoints and direction must match; do not relax to one endpoint
answer_semantics.accepted_mechanisms: preserve the source scorer's disjunction, including configuration_error for cases 001-003
answer_semantics.alternative_candidates: not additional asserted root causes and not an any-candidate correctness rule
answer_semantics.multi_fault: not demonstrated by these 14 selected cases; do not claim multi-fault-set performance

paper_metric_coverage.EM: not computed: saved diagnoses use typed loci and a different mechanism ontology, not the paper root_causes set contract
paper_metric_coverage.F1: not computed: same root-set contract and fault-kind equivalence gap
paper_metric_coverage.Precision: not computed: same root-set contract and fault-kind equivalence gap
paper_metric_coverage.Recall: not computed: same root-set contract and fault-kind equivalence gap
paper_metric_coverage.AnySvc: not computed: locus accuracy includes directed edges and infrastructure nodes and is not a service-only hit metric
paper_metric_coverage.PR: not computed: no final predicted propagation graph; RCA100 packages lack a paper-format verified causal graph
paper_metric_coverage.Node F1: not computed: same graph-output and graph-ground-truth gap
paper_metric_coverage.Edge F1: not computed: same graph-output and graph-ground-truth gap
paper_metric_coverage.SQL Exec: not computed: original query-ID citation validity is not the paper's per-case nonempty DuckDB evidence-SQL replay metric

claims.headline_superiority_test: not reported; historical and new models differ; paired HF analysis needs a complete cohort
